metadata.description: Security audit plugins for zero-knowledge systems: gnark circuits, their verifier contracts, protocol state and prover services.

plugins.name: zk-audit
plugins.description: Audits gnark (Go) ZK circuits end to end: hints, range checks, field arithmetic, gadgets, recursion, plus the verifier contract, protocol state and prover service that consume the proofs. Ships a gnark inventory tool, a sourced attack-vector catalog and schema-checked findings.
